title: Termwise slice restriction models and normalized adjunction map
statement: On a site (C,J), for a ring sheaf R, use termwise module restriction to C/U and termwise relocalization along f:U→V. The sectionwise identity gives moduleOverComplexComp. For rW≅rU⋙rUW with right adjoints RU,RW, define the restriction-adjunction map RU A→RW(rUW A) by transposing comp.hom followed by rUW of the U-counit. Small-model sheafification supplies the abelian sheafification instances at the chosen universe. These are the six existing definitions, with unchanged bodies and names.

source.place: Tag 08DG, right-direct-image and fibre calculation, extended to subterminal slices.

proof.text: Use Mathlib small-model sheafification, termwise functors, and overFunctorMap. Define the nested map by the displayed adjunction Hom bijection.

proof_origin.place: E9: the proof in the Lean module, with the source argument specialized to the stated slice-site interface.
